name: Pile of Orts

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-01: Intro to the Year of Battle's Spark: Enough is Enough

disable: DC 16 Arcana check, DC 16 Nature check, DC 16 Occultism check, or DC 16 Religion check (2 actions) (trained) while within 15 feet to weaken the rift, dealing 2d4 spirit damage to it. This damage has the holy trait.
routine: (1 action) The Hellknight commands the orts, and the trap lashes out at each enemy creature in its space and adjacent, dealing 1d6+3 slashing damage (DC 15 basic Reflex save save) If no enemy is in reach, an ort emerges in an adjacent square.

items.name: Hellfire
items.text: All orts within 30 feet have +1 status bonus to hit and deal 1d4 extra fire damage on a hit.

items.name: Bubble
items.text:
Trigger The trap receives a critical hit or critically fails a saving throw

---
Effect One ort emerges adjacent.

items.name: Planar Breach
items.text:
Trigger The magic circle is broken

---
Effect The pile disgorges orts and then rolls initiative

text: A rift to Hell crackles with unstable energy from the broken summoning circle as a squirming mass of fiends struggles to emerge A blood mist projection of a Hellknight angrily commands them.
